jobs.name: B_S02-02.c1_battle
jobs.prompt: xworld style, Image 1 is the line drawing of the battle: keep every soldier's place, size and pose, the river and the horizon exactly. Image 2 is the broad commander: draw him once, leading the charge at the point of the wedge. Two armies of lanky soldiers clash in a shallow river, spears lowered, banners snapping, spray rising from their boots, every soldier with his own face, helmet and shield, low golden sun through grey clouds.

jobs.name: B_S03-02_duel
jobs.prompt: xworld style, Image 1 is the line drawing of the scene: keep every figure's place, size and pose and the ground line exactly. Image 2 is the broad commander and Image 3 is the young scout: keep their faces, builds and clothes. In a castle courtyard of grey stone at hard noon the broad commander with a grey beard, a dented steel helmet and a red cloak raises his broadsword over the crouching young scout in a green hood, both with bulging eyes, boots scraping on sunlit stone.

jobs.name: C_D4_rain_150
jobs.prompt: xworld style, a long column of tired soldiers marches along a muddy road in heavy rain at the end of a lost day, lanky angular men with long thin legs, narrow shoulders and big dented helmets sliding over their eyes, each soldier different, one tall and bony, one short and round, one with a bandaged arm, cloaks soaked and heads bowed, spears carried crooked over their shoulders, horses with drooping heads and knobbly knees pulling a creaking cart loaded with wet sacks, a limp banner hanging from a bent pole, puddles splashing under heavy boots, ruts full of brown water, a broken fence along the roadside, a lone drummer boy at the front with a drum too big for him, bare hills on both sides with a few black twisted trees, storm clouds piled over the hills with one weak gold break of light far ahead.

jobs.name: C_D2_duel_150
jobs.prompt: xworld style, two swordsmen duel in a castle courtyard at harsh noon, a tall lanky swordsman with long arms and a pointed beard lunges with a wild grin while a short stocky one with a thick neck and bowed legs parries and sparks fly from the blades, soldiers in a loose ring watching with wide eyes, every watcher different, a skinny boy perched on a barrel, a fat cook with a ladle, an old guard leaning on his spear, a woman with a basket of apples, a toppled barrel rolling across the uneven cobbles, a nervous dog backing away with its tail down, a stone well with a wooden bucket, high stone walls with narrow windows and a wooden gallery, banners hanging still on the keep wall, laundry on a rope between two towers, hard sun straight above throwing short sharp shadows.
